title: Fatty acid desaturation controls cellular fate decisions between senescence and ferroptosis
title_zh: 脂肪酸去饱和控制细胞在衰老和铁死亡之间的命运决定
abstract: When subject to damage or stress, cells develop responses in order to maintain tissue homeostasis. Two such responses are ferroptosis and cellular senescence, but how cells decide between these outcomes remains unclear. Here, we show that senescent cells increase import and membrane levels of multiple polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), but a specific intermediate PUFA, dihomo-gamma-linolenic acid (DGLA, 20:3ω-6), is reduced. Exogenous repletion of DGLA instead results in cell death by ferroptosis. Senescent cells manifest additional features associated with ferroptosis, including labile iron and expression of lipoxygenases as well as low-level membrane peroxidation. Oral DGLA supplementation lowers markers of senescence in aged mice and improves age-related functional outcomes. Finally, obese humans with lowered DGLA desaturation rates have lower markers of adipose tissue senescence. Together, our data implicate shifts in PUFA metabolism as a driver of decisions between senescence and ferroptosis.
abstract_zh: 当细胞受到损伤或应激时，细胞会产生反应以维持组织稳态。两种此类反应是铁死亡和细胞衰老，但细胞如何在这两种结果之间做出选择仍不清楚。在此，我们显示衰老细胞增加多不饱和脂肪酸（PUFA）的摄入和膜水平，但特定的中间PUFA，二链伽马-亚麻酸（DGLA，20:3ω-6）水平降低。外源性DGLA补充反而导致细胞铁死亡。衰老细胞表现出与铁死亡相关的其他特征，包括易变铁和脂氧化酶的表达以及低水平的膜脂质过氧化。外源DGLA补充可降低老年小鼠的衰老标志，并改善与年龄相关的功能结局。最后，肥胖人群中DGLA去饱和率降低的个体，其脂肪组织衰老标志也降低。总之，我们的数据表明PUFA代谢的转变是衰老和铁死亡之间命运决定的驱动因素。
